title: Chili Rubbed Contra variation
author: Don Flaherty
problems: Row 4 "star right 4 places hands across" can't start from where the dancers are: A star of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.

Row 5 "mad robins, larks in front larks start in center and ricochet out with two hands robins in, ricochet out with two hands, larks in center and ricochet out two hands, robins allemande right in center 3/4 untill all the robins in middle to make a long wavy line in center," can't start from where the dancers are: A mad ricochet needs two dancers on each side line, one above the other.
Row 7 "partners swing" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 2's partner is outside the group.
choices: Give & take: half the beats to cross, half to back home holding both hands.
